Polynomial aliases and constructions

Source: R/zz-aliases.R, R/zzz-sym-names.R
poly-aliases.Rd

sym_poly() is Poly(), PurePoly() is a Poly() whose generators are the placeholders _0, _1, ... so that polynomials differing only in their generators compare equal, GroebnerBasis() is groebner(), and rootof(), RootOf() and ComplexRootOf() are CRootOf(). monic() divides by the leading coefficient, cofactors() returns the gcd and both cofactors, half_gcdex() the Bezout coefficient and gcd, pexquo() exact pseudo division, all_roots() all roots with multiplicity, solving linear and quadratic factors and binomials by radicals and giving CRootOf for the other factors. cyclotomic_poly(), symmetric_poly(), interpolating_poly() (in Lagrange form), random_poly(), itermonomials() and viete() build polynomials and formulas; legendre_poly(), chebyshevt_poly(), chebyshevu_poly(), hermite_poly(), hermite_prob_poly(), laguerre_poly() and jacobi_poly() return the explicit orthogonal polynomials. lex, grlex and grevlex name the monomial orders.

Usage

PurePoly(f, ...)

GroebnerBasis(f, ...)

rootof(f, x, k)

RootOf(f, x, k)

ComplexRootOf(f, x, k)

lex

grlex

grevlex

monic(f, ...)

cofactors(f, g, ...)

half_gcdex(f, g, ...)

pexquo(f, g, ...)

all_roots(f, x = NULL)

cyclotomic_poly(n, x = Symbol("x"))

symmetric_poly(k, vars)

interpolating_poly(n, x, X = NULL, Y = NULL)

random_poly(x, n, inf = -10, sup = 10)

itermonomials(vars, max_degree, min_degree = 0)

viete(f, x = NULL, roots = NULL)

legendre_poly(n, x = Symbol("x"))

chebyshevt_poly(n, x = Symbol("x"))

chebyshevu_poly(n, x = Symbol("x"))

hermite_poly(n, x = Symbol("x"))

hermite_prob_poly(n, x = Symbol("x"))

laguerre_poly(n, x = Symbol("x"))

jacobi_poly(n, a, b, x = Symbol("x"))

sym_poly(x, ...)

Arguments

...

Generators.

x, f, g

Expressions.

k

Order of the symmetric polynomial.

n

Degree, or number of variables.

vars

A list of symbols.

X, Y

Interpolation nodes and values.

inf, sup

Coefficient range for random_poly().

max_degree, min_degree

Degree bounds.

roots

A list of root symbols for viete().

a, b

Jacobi parameters.

Value

An expression, list or Poly.

Examples

x <- Symbol("x")
cyclotomic_poly(6, x)
#> x^2 - x + 1
cofactors(x^2 - 1, x - 1)
#> $h
#> x - 1
#> 
#> $cff
#> x + 1
#> 
#> $cfg
#> 1
#> 
viete(x^2 + Symbol("p") * x + Symbol("q"), x)
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]][[1]]
#> r1 + r2
#> 
#> [[1]][[2]]
#> -p
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]][[1]]
#> r1*r2
#> 
#> [[2]][[2]]
#> q
#> 
#>
